constraints.description: Define cube as a module-level callable in src/app_int/main.py with exactly one positional parameter; annotate that parameter and the return value, and provide a non-empty docstring. (AC-1, AC-9)
Implement cube using integer cubing semantics so the required positive, zero, one, and negative input/output cases are preserved. (AC-2, AC-3, AC-4)
Add at least one test function in a file under tests/ that imports cube from app_int.main and asserts its return value; cover all specified cube examples. (AC-2, AC-3, AC-4, AC-5)
Keep health_check() returning {"status": "ok"}, keep add(2, 3) returning 5, and retain the existing tests in tests/test_main.py. (AC-6)
The finished implementation must pass uv run pytest -q with no failures or errors. (AC-5, AC-6, AC-7)
The finished implementation must pass uv run ruff check . with exit status 0. (AC-8)

Do not add dependencies, database changes, or unrelated refactors; the requested function and focused test are sufficient. (Architectural decision: prefer the smallest change that satisfies all acceptance criteria.)
